en: A monastery on the shore beside ancient Lambousa, with a domed church of Byzantine and Gothic phases, whose name means 'made without hands'. It stands inside a Turkish military area and has been inaccessible and largely unmaintained since 1974.

en: Lapithos was the island's best-known pottery town, turning out glazed and slip-decorated earthenware jugs, bowls and storage jars on the wheel; museum collections of Cypriot folk pottery are largely Lapithos work, and the craft died with the displacement of 1974.
